create_insert_text_augmenter: create an InsertTextAugmenter to insert specified text into input text at a given location
augment_text_with_random_insertions: augment a list of texts by randomly inserting chosen phrases into each text
augment_text_with_prepend: augment texts by prepending a chosen phrase to the beginning of each text
augment_text_with_append: augment texts by appending a chosen phrase to the end of each text
augment_text_multiple_insertions: augment texts by inserting multiple random phrases at random word positions
